claim: § The Principle in Plain Language: each looping dimension adds one independent fundamental; irrational ratios open a lattice, rational ratios 'phase-lock' it back to a harmonic series; § Frame 3, above a critical coupling the spectrum collapses — bell to string as a bifurcation, not a morph.

pieces.what: Two loops with a ratio slider and a live spectrum: at 3/2 the partials fall on one harmonic series, nudge to golden ratio and the lattice opens — heard and seen
pieces.walks_up_from: one loop and its harmonic series

pieces.what: Frame 3: two coupled Karplus-Strong loops at an irrational ratio with a coupling knob; past threshold the bell snaps into a string — tests 'bifurcation, not a smooth morph'
Frame 2: two coupled combs give the same 2D lattice as the torus scan, shown side by side
Add loops one by one toward noise; the spectrum stays discrete — the limit heard
